title: Code of Virginia, Title 40.1 (Labor and Employment), Chapter 3 (Protection of Employees), Article 2 - Pay; Assignment of Wages; Sale of Merchandise to Employees

verified_how: fetched https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacode/title40.1/chapter3/ (HTTP 200): breadcrumb 'Table of Contents > Title 40.1. Labor and Employment > Chapter 3. Pay; Assignment of Wages; Sale of Merchandise to Employees' listing s 40.1-29 (Time and medium of payment; withholding wages; written statement of earnings; agreement for forfeiture of wages; proceedings to enforce compliance; penalties), 40.1-29.1, 40.1-29.2 (Employer liability), 40.1-29.3 (Overtime for certain employees), 40.1-30, 40.1-31, 40.1-32, 40.1-33, 40.1-33.1 and 40.1-33.2 - none marked 'Repealed' or '(Effective ...)'. Currency: the register's own 2026 Updates page (https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacodeupdates/) states 'this is a list of updated sections that took effect on July 1, 2026, unless otherwise noted', so the online Code reflects the 2026 session. The site marks future text as '(Effective <date>)' and dead text as 'Repealed', and the cited provisions carry neither marker. Note that article-level URLs such as /vacode/title40.1/chapter3/article2/ return HTTP 200 with an EMPTY content pane, so the citable register page for an article is its chapter page, which prints the article heading and its section list.
notes: The Virginia Minimum Wage Act is the adjacent Article 1.1 (ss 40.1-28.8 to 40.1-28.12), verified on the same page; s 40.1-28.9 appears there in three dated versions ('Effective until January 1, 2027', 'Effective January 1, 2027, until July 1, 2030', 'Effective July 1, 2030'), which shows the register does flag future text.
